descriptionChirho: The act or expression of giving thanks to God, a central element of Christian worship and prayer (1 Cor 14:16 'your thanksgiving', 2 Cor 4:15, 9:11-12; Eph 5:4; Phil 4:6; Col 2:7, 4:2; 1 Thess 3:9; 1 Tim 2:1, 4:3-4; Rev 4:9, 7:12). Used of both individual expressions and corporate liturgical thanksgiving. Multilingual evidence: eng 'thanksgiving/thanksgivings/thankfulness', spa 'accion-de-gracias/acciones-de-gracias/gratitud', hin 'dhanyavad/kritagyata', arb 'shukr', kor 'gamsa', swa 'shukrani'. All three clusters represent number/case inflections (singular, plural, genitive) of the same thanksgiving concept.
